notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.6
notes.content:
- fixed a bug where the player unit would get stuck in the floor after dieing inside a shield

 - updated the tutorial to explain that units should not be standing inside shields

 - the camera no longer travels to the top left corner if the mouse is outside the game window, while edge scrolling is enabled

 - opening the friends panel in the lobby now automatically closes the weapon selection to prevent overlapping

 - the tile borders in lobby map are now always uniform (the used to be slightly thinner on the outermost edge)

 - the center tile is no longer highlighted if the mouse is outside the game window, during a match.

notes.title: Teal is now also available on SteamOs and Linux
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Teal is now also available on SteamOS and Linux.

Patch 1.0.5

- Added hardware cursor support. The option is located in the Video section and is enabled by default
- The default unit and bot names are now randomly selected from a pool
- A message is now shown if the UI was hidden to avoid confusion
- Updated engine version
- Some minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
- fixed crash after waking from sleep mode
 - fixed bug where you would get the unit names of the opponent after leaving a match
 - added option to continue playing the audio, even when the window does not have focus
 - the text in the unit name box is now automatically selected when it gains focus
 - the chat in the lobby no longer loses focus after a message has been sent
